skill.name: orchestrate-task

meta.description: Decompose a new feature, fix, or refactor into scoped agent units. Reads docs/, writes docs/current_task.xml, produces a dispatch plan with agent assignments and dependency order.
meta.trigger_phrases: start task, new feature, plan this, break this down, create task for, what do we need to do, decompose this

steps.step: Read in order: docs/Purpose.xml, docs/context.xml, docs/current_task.xml. If docs/current_task.xml has status="in_progress" or "in_review": output BLOCKED: "Close TASK-[ID] before starting a new one." stop.

Break request into units. Each unit must satisfy all four: One agent role: implementer-backend | implementer-frontend | reviewer One outcome, one layer: UI | API | DB | config Zero file-scope overlap with any sibling unit Explicit dependency on prior unit IDs listed

Write docs/current_task.xml with these fields: Task ID, Goal, Background files_in_scope — explicit list, no wildcards files_out_of_scope — explicit list acceptance_criteria — each independently verifiable known_facts — from docs/context.xml only, no inference unknowns — agent must output BLOCKED if any remain unresolved implementation_plan — numbered steps test_plan
Output unit sequence: Unit N | agent-role | files: [...] | depends: [unit IDs or "none"] Final unit is always: reviewer | diff + docs/current_task.xml acceptance criteria.

Before finalizing, verify none of these are present: Required fact absent from docs/context.xml — update context.xml first. Schema or API contract change needed — escalate to engineer. New dependency needed — security check before task proceeds. Auth, session, or validation boundary change — escalate to engineer. If any match — output BLOCKED with the specific condition.

skill.output_format:
TASK-[ID]: [goal] Status: READY | BLOCKED ([reason])
Units: 1. [role] | files: [...] | depends: none 2. [role] | files: [...] | depends: unit-1 N. reviewer | diff + docs/current_task.xml | depends: unit-N-1
Dispatch contract prepended to each agent: "Read docs/Purpose.xml, docs/context.xml, docs/current_task.xml. Restate goal, scope, and criteria. List files to modify. If anything is missing — stop and ask."

escalation.path: Stay in orchestrator. Resolve blocker, replan.
Dispatch with diff and acceptance criteria.
